# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities privately by emailing hello+security@sergiodxa.com
or by sending me a Discord DM at @sergiodxa.

Include the affected app or package, reproduction steps, expected impact, and any
relevant logs or screenshots. Do not open a public issue for suspected security
problems.

Responsible vulnerability reports are appreciated. This project does not operate
a paid bug bounty or compensation program.

## Response

I will review reports as soon as possible and follow up with next steps. Valid
reports are fixed privately first, then disclosed publicly when appropriate.
